surface: Codex desktop review with Playwright CLI and two isolated headless Chrome browser sessions

target.kind: Existing private web application with customer sign-in, workspace-scoped authorization and PostgreSQL
target.identity_revision_source_and_raw_traces: Retained locally; no private app source or endpoint names published

browser.flow: Actual NextAuth email-code forms and session cookies; delivery used the app development simulation

baseline.candidate_disposition: Retained as needs_review outside the declared browser/customer auth focus; not adjudicated as vulnerabilities

review.finding_details: Retained locally while the app finding is unfixed; public aggregate excludes mechanism, source locations and reproducer

checks.foreign_record_selector: returned only the caller records, never the other user sentinel
checks.logout: UI sign-out cleared the signed-out user session and protected data returned 401; other browser remained signed in
checks.final_database_state: expected membership roles and sentinel record identities retained
checks.finding_validation: Local real HTTP authentication boundary failure reproduced; full conditions and raw outcome retained locally

containment.database: Fresh PostgreSQL with the full app schema and only synthetic users/workspaces/records

limitations: Local development email-code flow; no live mail delivery or production Clerk/Google/OAuth sign-in.
A confirmed finding is not a production exposure or impact claim; details await app remediation.
Selected customer team/record/switch/member-role paths were tested; not every resource, invitation, billing or outbound path.
Stolen pre-logout cookie replay/global revocation was not tested.
104 broader baseline leads remain needs_review; sparse-source skips are explicit.
Initial runtime/plan fixture mismatches were corrected before final authorization assertions.
Private source makes this public summary independently unreproducible; not a blind benchmark or security certification.
No new ChatNoir runtime defect was found, so no runtime patch or version bump was needed.
